R8A-camp-camp-0001.name: Lodestone Lake rec site
R8A-camp-camp-0001.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a rec site (estimate).

evidence.t: Named water: easy to find on any map.
1 km or more from pavement and from private land: quieter (estimate).

flags.t: Spot is inside a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Thompson, Cariboo and Okanagan Alpines. Closed Year Round. Exemption: Snowmobiles exempt year round (January 1 to December 31). Synopsis map 1-82/24.

plan: Drive: from Town of Princeton, about 35 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Copper Mountain Rd, Tulameen Ave, Coalmont Rd, Blakeburn Rd. Official directions to Lodestone Lake rec site: From Princeton take the Coalmont Rd.
Park: 49.46589, -120.84831, the rec site. Map links below.
Camp: 2 campsites (official).
Hunt: 5 hunting spots within 5 km of this camp (my pick).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 8-5, Region 8. 2 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.

R8A-camp-camp-0001.recDirections: From Princeton take the Coalmont Rd. for 18 kms to the town of Coalmont. Go straight at the stop sign and follow the road as it turns left. Turn right and cross the bridge south across the river, turn left onto Rice Road. Follow for 1 km and then turn right onto Blakeburn FSR. Be careful of heavy industrial traffic. Continue to 9 km where the road changes to 30 km the Lodestone FSR. Follow Lodestone for 6.5 kms and turn left. Follow this road keeping right at 1 km then take right at 3 kms. Take this rough and steep 4X4 road for 1 km to the lake.

R8A-grouse-drive-0002.name: By Whipsaw Creek
R8A-grouse-drive-0002.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R8A-grouse-drive-0002.parkWhat: pull off on Whipsaw Creek FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: Road: Whipsaw Creek FSR, 5.6 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
12 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
16 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 8 table, so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).
private land only, with the landowner's permission

plan: Drive: from Town of Princeton, about 23 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Copper Mountain Rd, Hwy 3, Whipsaw Creek Rd, Whipsaw Creek FSR.
Park: 49.27266, -120.75974, pull off on Whipsaw Creek FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Whipsaw Creek FSR stretch, 5.6 km one way. About 112 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 8-5, Region 8. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
